history_vintages.business_line: natural gas distribution (Oklahoma, Kansas, Texas) and energy services; the general partner of ONEOK Partners, L.P. (NYSE: OKS), consolidated

eps_first_excluded.2001: the AAPL FY2002 test: $0.36 a diluted share from continuing operations and income from continuing operations of $43.5M (FY2005 10-K, the latest filing that reports the year, the production segment discontinued), against the FY2001 10-K's two listed items, $72.0M together ('The impact of the OCC ruling related to the recovery of gas costs from the 2000/2001 winter reduced operating income by $34.6 million and the impact of the Enron bankruptcy reduced operating income by $37.4 million in 2001.'), so reported EPS is under half the year's EPS without them ($0.36 against $0.36 + $72.0M / 99.7M diluted shares = $1.08), and no filing publishes a figure excluding only them; a distorted year that is not the latest takes the years before it (the ACN FY02 and AAPL FY2002 rule), so the history starts with FY2002 and the P/E window on 2002-01-01, which also leaves out fiscal 1997-1999 (years to August 31) and the four-month transition period to December 31, 1999

eps_guides.quote: The company also reaffirmed its previous 2007 earnings guidance, but narrowed the range to $2.50 to $2.70 per diluted share
ONEOK, Inc. (NYSE: OKE) today reaffirmed its previous 2007 earnings guidance in the range of $2.50 to $2.70 per diluted share
The company also increased its previous 2007 earnings guidance to a range of $2.62 to $2.72 per diluted share
ONEOK also increased its net income guidance for 2007 to $2.75 to $2.79 per diluted share
ONEOK’s net income guidance for 2008 is in the range of $2.75 to $3.15 per diluted share.
ONEOK also reaffirmed its 2008 net income guidance, announced on Jan. 8, 2008, in the range of $2.75 to $3.15 per diluted share.
ONEOK raised its 2008 net income guidance to the range of $2.90 to $3.10 per diluted share from the range of $2.75 to $3.15 per diluted share.
The company also affirmed its 2008 net income guidance, but narrowed the range to $2.95 to $3.05 per diluted share
We also affirmed our net income guidance for 2008 of $2.95 to $3.05 per diluted share.
Our 2009 net income guidance is estimated to be in the range of $2.25 to $2.75 per diluted share.
ONEOK also reaffirmed its 2009 earnings per share guidance, announced on Feb. 5, 2009, in the range of $2.25 to $2.75 per diluted share.
ONEOK also updated its 2009 earnings per share guidance to the range of $2.40 to $2.70 per diluted share from its previous range of $2.25 to $2.75 per diluted share
The company also increased its 2009 net income guidance to the range of $2.65 to $2.85 per diluted share
